workflowBlueprints.useCase: A funding team receives leads from a form or approved intake source.
workflowBlueprints.outcome: A single CRM record is ready for a broker to review, with source and next action visible.
requiredServices: Secure document provider for later collection
workflowBlueprints.trigger: A new intake submission is received
inputs: Banded business context; no raw documents

flowSteps.label: Validate
flowSteps.detail: Check required fields and consent flags without making a funding decision.

flowSteps.label: Normalize
flowSteps.detail: Map source, contact route and banded context into the existing CRM fields.

flowSteps.label: Check for prior records
flowSteps.detail: Flag possible duplicates for a person instead of merging on name or email alone.

flowSteps.label: Queue review
flowSteps.detail: Create a broker task and a neutral receipt acknowledgment only where consent permits.

setupSteps: Map the exact approved form fields to the CRM's existing record.
Define which missing fields block the queue and which need a human follow-up.
Test consent, duplicate and failure paths with fictional records.
workflowBlueprints.humanReview: A broker reviews the inquiry and decides all funding next steps; the workflow never qualifies or approves a borrower.
workflowBlueprints.failureNotes: On invalid data or a failed CRM write, retain only an event reference and alert an operator; avoid duplicate creation on retry.
workflowBlueprints.maintenanceNotes: Review field mappings, consent text and the queue owner when intake forms or CRM fields change.

workflowBlueprints.title: Request missing intake information safely
workflowBlueprints.summary: Identify absent intake fields, prepare a focused request and return the record to a human-owned review queue without guessing borrower facts.
workflowBlueprints.useCase: A submitted funding inquiry lacks information needed for an initial broker conversation.
workflowBlueprints.outcome: The broker sees the gaps and can approve a concise, consent-aware request.
workflowBlueprints.trigger: A new intake record is marked incomplete

flowSteps.label: Identify gaps
flowSteps.detail: Compare the record with the team's required-field checklist.

flowSteps.label: Draft request
flowSteps.detail: Prepare only the missing non-sensitive questions and a secure upload reference if needed.

flowSteps.label: Review and send
flowSteps.detail: Have the owner approve wording, channel and timing before sending.

flowSteps.label: Track response
flowSteps.detail: Update the task when the person replies; do not infer a funding result.

setupSteps: Write the required-field checklist for each intake source.
Set consent and opt-out checks before any message branch.
Assign an owner for unanswered or bounced requests.
workflowBlueprints.humanReview: A broker or processor approves the request and decides whether the response is sufficient for further review.
workflowBlueprints.failureNotes: If contact details, consent or a secure link are missing, hold the message and create a manual task.
workflowBlueprints.maintenanceNotes: Review question wording and required fields after changes to the intake process.

workflowBlueprints.title: Flag possible duplicate leads for review
workflowBlueprints.summary: Surface possible duplicate CRM records before creating a new deal, while preserving each original record and its source attribution.
workflowBlueprints.useCase: The same business may appear through a form, phone call or referral source.
workflowBlueprints.outcome: An operator receives a comparison task and decides whether records represent the same case.
workflowBlueprints.trigger: An intake event matches an existing record on one or more configured signals
inputs: Existing record references and non-sensitive match signals
outputs: Decision log with original record references

flowSteps.label: Search
flowSteps.detail: Look for possible matches using more than one signal.

flowSteps.label: Flag
flowSteps.detail: Keep both records intact and show the differing context to a reviewer.

flowSteps.label: Resolve
flowSteps.detail: Let an authorized operator choose the correct record and next action.

flowSteps.label: Record
flowSteps.detail: Log the resolution without erasing prior source attribution.

setupSteps: Define match signals and false-positive examples for the existing CRM.
Keep merge and delete actions outside the automation.
Test repeated email, shared business names and partner referral cases.
workflowBlueprints.humanReview: Only an authorized person may decide whether to merge, link or keep records separate; name or email alone is insufficient.
workflowBlueprints.failureNotes: If search fails, create the new intake in a review state with a possible-duplicate warning rather than merging automatically.
workflowBlueprints.maintenanceNotes: Review false positives and match rules as data sources change.

workflowBlueprints.title: Send a reviewed secure document request
workflowBlueprints.summary: Move from broker review to a secure upload request with a clear checklist and consent-aware reminders, without putting files into automation payloads.
workflowBlueprints.useCase: A broker has decided which documents are appropriate to request for a specific inquiry.
workflowBlueprints.outcome: The borrower receives an approved secure upload route and the team can track receipt by reference.
workflowBlueprints.trigger: A broker authorizes a document request
inputs: Secure upload link or folder reference
outputs: Secure upload reference on the CRM record

flowSteps.label: Approve checklist
flowSteps.detail: Broker checks the requested items for this case.

flowSteps.label: Create secure route
flowSteps.detail: Generate or retrieve a secure upload reference; keep file bytes outside the CRM and messages.

flowSteps.label: Send request
flowSteps.detail: Send the approved link and checklist through an allowed channel.

flowSteps.label: Track state
flowSteps.detail: Record only request and receipt status, then create a human task if it remains open.

setupSteps: Connect the existing secure upload service to the CRM by reference only.
Define approved checklist language and consent checks.
Set reminder limits and an escalation owner before enabling sends.
workflowBlueprints.humanReview: A broker determines which documents to request and reviews any financial or identity material in the secure provider.
workflowBlueprints.failureNotes: If the secure link cannot be created or a send fails, pause the sequence and notify the owner; never fall back to email attachments.
workflowBlueprints.maintenanceNotes: Review link expiry, consent, reminder caps and secure-provider permissions regularly.

workflowBlueprints.title: Hand off a secure document receipt
workflowBlueprints.summary: Acknowledge an upload event, record only a secure file reference and alert the assigned broker that material is ready for human review.
workflowBlueprints.useCase: A secure upload provider reports that a requested file has arrived.
workflowBlueprints.outcome: The broker has a review task and a reference to the file in the secure system.
requiredServices: Secure document upload provider with receipt event
workflowBlueprints.trigger: A secure upload provider sends a completed-upload event
inputs: CRM record ID and upload event ID
Secure file reference and document type; no file contents
outputs: Receipt status on the CRM record

flowSteps.label: Verify event
flowSteps.detail: Confirm the upload event belongs to the expected record.

flowSteps.label: Store reference
flowSteps.detail: Write only the secure file reference and receipt status.

flowSteps.label: Alert broker
flowSteps.detail: Create a task for the assigned reviewer without copying document contents.

flowSteps.label: Acknowledge
flowSteps.detail: Send a neutral receipt confirmation only when the approved process permits.

setupSteps: Map secure-provider event IDs and CRM record IDs.
Define retry behavior using the event ID so duplicate webhooks do not create duplicate tasks.
Test expired links and mismatched record IDs with fictional data.
workflowBlueprints.humanReview: A broker reviews the actual document in the secure provider and decides whether more information is needed.
workflowBlueprints.failureNotes: Hold unknown or mismatched file references for operator investigation; never include document text in error logs.
workflowBlueprints.maintenanceNotes: Review webhook signatures, access permissions and retention settings with the secure provider.

workflowBlueprints.title: Escalate leads without a recorded first contact
workflowBlueprints.summary: Watch the team's chosen response window and alert an owner when an intake remains uncontacted, while respecting business hours and consent.
workflowBlueprints.useCase: New inquiries may sit in a CRM queue without an assigned or completed first contact.
workflowBlueprints.outcome: A manager or broker receives an actionable exception task before a lead is forgotten.
workflowBlueprints.trigger: A scheduled check finds a received record past its configured contact window
inputs: Team business hours and escalation rule

flowSteps.label: Find open records
flowSteps.detail: Query received records with no recorded first contact.

flowSteps.label: Apply local rule
flowSteps.detail: Compare elapsed business time with the team's configured service window.

flowSteps.label: Notify owner
flowSteps.detail: Send a reference-only internal alert to the assigned person or overflow queue.

flowSteps.label: Close exception
flowSteps.detail: Clear the alert when contact is logged or a person resolves it.

setupSteps: Define the response window and business timezone.
Choose an overflow owner for unassigned records.
Test holidays, reassignments and duplicate alerts.
workflowBlueprints.humanReview: A person decides how to contact the borrower and whether any further action is appropriate.
workflowBlueprints.failureNotes: If CRM timestamps are missing or future-dated, mark the record for manual review rather than calculating a false overdue state.
workflowBlueprints.maintenanceNotes: Review response windows, owner rosters and alert volume monthly.

outputs: Attribution exception task when the source is unknown

flowSteps.label: Capture source
flowSteps.detail: Carry the partner or campaign identifier from the approved intake event.

flowSteps.label: Resolve reference

flowSteps.label: Record or flag

flowSteps.label: Audit handoff

Define who can resolve unknown references.
Test repeated submissions and attribution conflicts.

workflowBlueprints.maintenanceNotes: Review mappings when the partner system or intake source changes; reconcile exceptions with the owning operations team.

workflowBlueprints.outcome: A reviewer sees a checklist of available references, missing items and unresolved questions.

Required item checklist for this case

flowSteps.label: Collect references

flowSteps.label: Check completeness

flowSteps.label: Prepare review

flowSteps.label: Decide next step

workflowBlueprints.title: Prepare a privacy-safe operations digest
workflowBlueprints.summary: Summarize counts of new, open and exception records for an internal operator without including document contents or detailed borrower financial data.

workflowBlueprints.outcome: An internal digest shows aggregate activity and a short list of records requiring human attention.
workflowBlueprints.trigger: A daily or weekly internal reporting schedule

flowSteps.label: Collect counts
flowSteps.detail: Query the existing CRM for stage counts and open task references.

flowSteps.label: Check scope
flowSteps.detail: Remove sensitive fields and apply the reporting window.

flowSteps.label: Format digest
flowSteps.detail: Show counts, changes and exception references without document content.

flowSteps.label: Review delivery
flowSteps.detail: Send only to authorized internal operators.

setupSteps: Choose the reporting window and timezone.
Define the minimum fields needed for counts and exception links.

workflowBlueprints.failureNotes: If a source query fails, label the digest incomplete and alert the operator instead of showing a misleading zero.
workflowBlueprints.maintenanceNotes: Review metric definitions and recipients whenever CRM stages or team access change.

flowSteps.label: Review

flowSteps.label: Reconcile
